_meta.units: grams per lb bodyweight per day unless noted
_meta.notes: Paraphrased numeric guidance. Maintenance calorie table (Ch10 Table 10.1) not extracted; see maintenance_estimate.

priority_weights._caveat: Effective only to the degree the user adheres

fat.timing: bias away from training; toward long gaps and bedtime

day_classification.rule: When unsure: cut -> pick the lighter class; gain -> pick the harder class

maintenance_estimate.method: Start from an estimate, then calibrate from 2-3 weeks of bodyweight trend
maintenance_estimate._todo: Book Table 10.1 is an image. Use a standard BMR x activity formula as the starting estimate, or transcribe manually.

mini_cut.rate: slightly faster than a standard cut

maintenance._note: May need to lengthen when running repeated cut/maintenance cycles

cut_to_maintenance: Jump to midpoint between current intake and estimated maintenance
Hold 2 weeks; if stable, wait 1 more week then raise ~20%
Repeat every 3-4 weeks while stable until near estimated maintenance
Still losing: add back weekly deficit (lb lost x 3500 / 7 per day)
Gaining: hold until stable 3 weeks, then resume step-ups
transitions.gain_to_maintenance: If still gaining, subtract the surplus implied by the last 2 weeks' average gain
transitions.gain_to_mini_cut: Treat current intake as maintenance, then apply cut deficit
transitions.mini_cut_to_gain: Estimate maintenance and add the gain surplus

supplements_supported._caveat: Small effect even for the best-supported ones

hydration.exceptions: heavy sweat or heat -> deliberate plan with electrolytes
